usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; the only content is a short list of identity anchors (born 1970 Beirut, Franco-Lebanese, chairman of CMA CGM, son of founder Jacques Saadé, head of group since Nov 2017). A reader gets basic identity and current role, but nothing on actions, career history, or stakes. The dossier nowhere states what it does not know, but the empty body makes incompleteness at least visible rather than implied. Marginal meeting prep from anchors alone; the unjustified-conclusion warnings (founder vs heir, net-worth estimates, ownership vs editorial control) are useful caveats but no claims exist to match them to.
